# Ready: what the released plugin can do

<!-- Generated by plugin/ready.py on 2026-11-10; do not edit by hand. -->

The single list of what the plugin ships, written by `claude/skills/pratica/portal/scoreboard.py --write` (`make coverage`) from the same counts as [coverage.md](coverage.md). Read this, not a hand-built list.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin version | 0.6.2 (`plugin/impresa-in-un-minuto/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`) |
| Repo commit | `6fecad63de0a213065caf3175289a57dab720452` plus uncommitted changes |
| Generated | 2026-11-10 |
| Sportelli shipped | SUE (building works), as `plugin/build.yaml` `sportelli` says |
| Not shipped | SUAP (businesses): mapped in the repo, not in the plugin |

The three claims, as [coverage.md](coverage.md) states them:

- **Mapped**: the pratica is crawled (`catalogue/F839/sections/`): we know its sections and boxes.
- **Fillable**: mapped, and the dictionary fills every section of it, so `gen.py` can write its
  steps file. Nothing has touched the portal yet.
- **Run on the portal**: fillable, and a rehearsal generated from it has a run in its
  `runs.json` (the README's run table) that **filled** the draft: every value read back on a fresh load, with made-up
  people. Never declared, paid, signed or sent: that is the person's, by design.

No real case has been checked by an architect who files these pratiche (level 5). Every row below stops short of it.
